children: World Bank President Ajay Banga said he would meet on Monday with Senegalese ​President Bassirou Diomaye Faye to discuss the West African country's plans to seek a debt restructuring under the Group of 20 Common Framework.
‌"We're going to discuss how we can be helpful to ensure that his case goes through the G20 Common Framework at the fastest speed of any of the prior cases," Banga told Reuters.

Banga said G20 members had worked to reform the G20 debt treatment process and accelerate the timeline for completing a restructuring, and Senegal should be able to benefit from the experience garnered.

title: World Bank's Banga eyes faster G20 debt restructuring for Senegal
